motivation: Audit found shared successful suffixes for all 418 task-family units in the existing larger pool and redundant PASS routes receiving equal BC supervision. This is a finite-pool objective issue, not proof of the root cause of navigation failures.

exploratory_positive_signal: Report perseed Ours-minus-B2 CHECK branch both-correct counts and average; a nonnegative difference on all seeds with a positive mean is only a development signal. interpretation: No paper readiness, blind generalization, SR40 or deployment claim. Existing exposed CHECK used for diagnostic iteration must be disclosed. No outcome-dependent retraining or head selection.
